topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: This is in addition to the expenses of the underlying investments that you may hold in your plan (e.g., annual operating expenses of mutual funds).
question: Misconception: “If I pay fees for my 401(k) plan, that covers all the costs of investing in it.”
answer: Plan operating and administrative expenses may be passed on to participants, but they are separate from expenses charged by the underlying investments you hold, such as mutual fund operating expenses. Consider both types when reviewing your plan’s fees.
